problems:
# Hungary — notes

- Source used: KSH "Területi statisztikai évkönyv" (Regional Statistical Yearbook) chapter 3.8 Justice, table 3.8.2 "Egyes kiemelt bűncselekmények" for editions 2014–2024 (PDF per year, downloaded from ksh.hu/evkonyvek). First column = "Szándékos (befejezett) emberölés" / intentional completed homicide, registered, by place of commission. Covers 19 counties + Budapest, 7 régió, 2 nagyrégió, national total and "of which counties" subtotal. Earlier editions (2010–2013) are not at the same URL pattern (404 / connection reset); not extracted.
- KSH STADAT 11.1.2.1 "Registered crimes by county and region" (iga0008, 2009–2025) has NO homicide column (only total, battery, drugs, DUI, assault on officials, public nuisance, larceny) — downloaded CSV confirms. Direct direct download to ksh.hu STADAT html returns "Request Rejected" (WAF); CSV works with a browser User-Agent.
- Dashes in PDF (–, −, ─) treated as blank/zero-published ("–" = no case). Csongrád became Csongrád-Csanád from 2020 edition.
- Not extracted: ENyÜBS (bsr.bm.hu) interactive system by county and offence — would give more years; police.hu county annual evaluations (évértékelő) PDFs per county.
- Licence: none stated in the PDFs.
